android.releaseNotes:
• Apple Liquid Glass Bottom Nav Pill: Floating navbar pill in authentic liquid glass with label-free layout.
• Draggable Circular Indicator: Smooth horizontal drag gestures, spring snapping, and tactile haptics.
• Progressive Blur Backdrop: Soft gradient blur fading behind the bottom bar.
